==Description==
The '''Mini DJ Booth Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the default Level 5 [[DJ Booth]] skin. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for the [[DJ Booth]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards.

The goggles are detachable and glow in dark. It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton. It is 10.6 inches wide, 9.8 inches tall and 6.3 inches deep, or 26.924 centimetres wide, 24.892 centimetres tall and 16.002 centimetres deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Mini DJ Booth Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online (Second)'''
*:Drop the beats and defend the base. This mini plush brings rhythm and power to your shelf. This plush does not include an in-game reward.
*'''Online (First)'''
*:Drop the beats and defend the base. This mini plush brings rhythm and power to your shelf. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward. 

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Mini DJ Booth Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] or the in-game Merch Shop for $26.99.
